name: Grid Image Loader
title: Grid Image Loader
description: A dark grid loader with smooth cycling phrases, images on cursor hover, and an upward content reveal.
summary: Move across the grid to reveal photographs inside each hovered cell. Centered phrases change with a scoped GSAP sequence before the loading curtain lifts. Customize phrases, images, grid dimensions, timing, colors and progress. The showcase opens onto the requested Virat Kohli photograph.
highlights: Images align precisely to hovered grid cells
Smooth centered phrase transitions synchronized to loading
Bounded reusable image pool with fading cards
Shared cursor-loader lifecycle, progress, pause and replay
Upward curtain reveals children after loading
anatomy: <GridImageLoader> configured wrapper around the shared cursor-loader engine
Fixed cell image cards with an entrance and fade timeline
Loading curtain and inert content layer

physics.description: Each hover card reuses an entrance, hold and fade timeline. Grid coordinates come from container measurements, and resize observation keeps cards aligned. One master timeline synchronizes loading phases and curtain motion. Phrase timelines, pointer listeners and observers are cleaned up on unmount.

accessibility.aria: Progress is labeled; grid, phrases and hover images are decorative. Revealed content stays inert and hidden from assistive technology until completion.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Image and phrase animations are disabled. Automatic loading reveals immediately; controlled loading waits for 100%.

recommended: Image-led landing pages and portfolio introductions
Brief loading sequences with customizable editorial phrases
Use real controlled progress for production loading
bestPractices: Provide descriptive alt text for revealed content through children
Use landscape hover images for wide cells
Hover imagery requires a fine pointer; loading still completes on touch devices
Use replayKey to replay and paused to suspend all motion
Keep the phase duration long enough for phrases to be read

props.name: images
props.description: Hover image URLs. Loaded images cycle as the pointer enters new grid cells; failed images are skipped.

props.name: progress
props.description: Controlled loading progress from 0 to 100. Omit for automatic progress.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Duration of the upward curtain reveal in seconds.

props.name: trailLifetime
props.description: Image hold before fading, in seconds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Pause or resume the loader and active image animations.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change to restart loading from zero.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once after the content is revealed.

props.name: messages
props.description: Centered loading phrases, shown in sequence as loading progresses. Up to 12 nonempty phrases are supported.

props.name: gridColumns
props.description: Number of grid columns, bounded to 2–8.

props.name: gridRows
props.description: Number of grid rows, bounded to 2–8.
